title: Repeat-Issue Share on Late-Delivery Fee Refunds for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
**Training note.**

A late-delivery fee refund on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders carries a repeat-issue share that counts the return authorizations on the order, in any status, whose reason is damaged, defective, wrong item or not as described. The share is added to the refund share.

| Such return authorizations on the order | Repeat-issue share added |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 10% |
| Exactly one | 5% |
| None | Nothing |

### Questions answered

**Does the status of the authorization matter?** No. Authorized, received, refunded, rejected and expired authorizations all count.

**Which reasons count?** Damaged, defective, wrong item and not as described. Changed-mind and quality-guarantee authorizations do not.

**Example (hypothetical).** An order with one rejected damage request and one refunded wrong-item authorization has two such authorizations; the repeat-issue share added is 10%.
